Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), game text: “USED: Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Close Call, Gravity Shadow, Overwhelmed, or They've Shut Down The Main Reactor. [Immune to Sense.]”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_062321.pdf Errata Sheet 2021 Summer] (Players Committee), page 1, PDF built 22 June 2021. The slip was cut from the page rendered at 300 dpi (the PDF draws its text over a background image), at the slip's outline.

Edits: none.
